body_markdown:
We’re heading to sunny San Diego for NextGen UGM 2026, joining ambulatory providers and medical practice executives from across the country. As specialty practices focus on enhancing clinical throughput and simplifying regulatory compliance, eFax® is ready to showcase our cloud-based document management tools.


Connect with our experts in San Diego to discover how our digital fax solutions eliminate paper bottlenecks during patient registration and record transfers. Designed for seamless system interoperability and maximum security, eFax® allows ambulatory care teams to minimize manual administrative tasks and maintain their focus on patient care.
